COSPPac Regional ICT Workshop

Four hands-on sessions. Pick one to open its page - each has worked examples you can look at, the code behind them, and boxes to try your own URLs in.

Practical 1 System Maintenance and Planning Keeping a system healthy: reading logs, spotting the warning signs early, and planning the routine checks that stop small faults becoming outages. Open practical Practical 2 Data Formats and Storage The formats ocean data arrives in - CSV, JSON, GeoJSON and XML - what each is good at, and how to open and plot them. Open practical Practical 3 API Integration Reading an API address, calling it from a web page, and turning the reply into a live sea level reading anyone can understand. Open practical Practical 4 Embedding Ocean Products in your website Four ways to put content from another website on your own page: fetch data and draw a chart, show a finished picture, embed a PDF, or embed a whole web page.
